name: What are the risks of ignoring a leaking window?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks of ignoring a leaking window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ignoring a leaking window can lead to significant and costly problems. Prolonged water intrusion can cause structural damage to your home's walls, framing, and foundation, potentially compromising stability. It also creates an ideal environment for mold and mildew growth, which can pose health risks and degrade indoor air quality. Furthermore, it can damage interior finishes like drywall and paint, reduce energy efficiency, and lead to higher utility bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ignoring a leak risks structural damage, mold growth, health issues, damaged interior finishes, and reduced energy efficiency. Prompt repair prevents costly future problems.
